description: XPath Lexer: expected tokens for each XSLT select attribute

tests.label: nestedLetFor1
tests.xpath: for $i in 1 to 3 return let $j := $i * 2 return $j + 1

tests.label: nestedForLet
tests.xpath: for $x in (1,2) return for $y in (3,4) return let $z := $x + $y return $z * 2

tests.label: if6
tests.xpath: if (5 > 10) then (1, if (2 = 2) then 2 else 3) else (4, 5)

tests.label: if8
tests.xpath: for $i in 1 to 2 return if ($i = 1) then ('first', $i) else ('second', $i)

tests.label: switchSub1
tests.xpath: let $x := 1 return if ($x = 1) then 'one' else if ($x = 2) then 'two' else 'other'
